text:
joel: Quick question — for the early-adopter pricing pilot, can Legal permit per-account surge exemptions (i.e., carveouts for pilot customers) without creating a precedent we can't retract later? Need a decision for next-week SOWs.

mira: We should be careful. If we allow carveouts we need strict guardrails: duration, hard caps, and no SLA changes.

kevin: Sales will push for blanket carveouts. My suggestion: single-customer exception window max 90d, max 2x baseline qps, must have exec approval and legal sign-off.

tara: Launch criteria checklist (high level): 1) pilot <=3% pooled capacity impact, 2) p95 latency delta <10%, 3) documented fallback (auto-throttle to standard tier), 4) billing label & playbook.

sales_ana: FWIW CustomerPlum asked for "unlimited surge" for 6 months in the SOW. That's not acceptable. We can offer a purchasable surge add-on + an Early-Adopter Credit that auto-expires.

kevin: Proposed contract language snippet: "Early Adopter Surge Credit — Redwood grants a one-time surge credit equal to N compute units. Credits expire 180 days from activation; any overage billed at published surge rates. Exceptions require VP approval"

mira: For product, we need a config we can enforce. Example (dev config):

```yaml
add_on:
  id: ea_surge_credit
  grant_units: 100000
  multiplier_cap: 2.0
  expiry_days: 180
  require_exec_approval: true
```

mira: That lets infra enforce both cap and timeout.

ops-bot: Created ticket PR-3987: add enforcement checks and billing labels for EA surge credits (owner=tara, due=2025-06-06).

tara: Operational notes: we need a console flag to show active EA exceptions, billing tag propagation, and an alert when exceptions hit 70% of granted units. Also add a runbook for manual rollback.

joel: Sounds good. Next steps: draft guardrail doc + contract snippet, legal sign-off, update SOW template, add pilot offer page.

mira: I'll draft the guardrail doc by EOD Friday and include the config example. @kevin please DM top-3 likely customers so we can pre-author exceptions if needed.

kevin: Will DM the list and attach to PR-3987.

sales_ana: Also suggest we include a built-in safety cap: even exceptions can't exceed 3x baseline. Sales can sell extra capacity but ops will enforce.

tara: +1 on safety cap. Ops can't be in a position to absorb unlimited.

joel: If we land on 2x for pilot and 3x absolute max in contracts, that feels reasonable. Agree to escalate any deviations to SLA governance.

tara: :+1:

kevin: tagging legal for visibility — @mira will loop in counsel when draft is ready.

ops-bot: PR-3987 updated: added fields grant_units, multiplier_cap, expiry_days, approval_required.

mira: Thanks. We'll reconvene after the draft; aim to lock contract language next Wednesday.
